instruction: You begin in a living room facing a gray fireplace directly ahead of you with a small black table just a few feet in front of you and a white couch to your left. You're going to turn to the right and you're going to see a door that leads to an outdoor patio. Walk through the door entrance and take one step outside towards the small grey table in between two larger seats. Then what you're going to do is you're going to turn back around and walk right back into the home but you're going to walk in between the brown table, which is now on your right, and the brown chair, which you can see on your left. You're gonna keep going until you reach the corner of the wall that is situated next to a small white piece eof furniture which features multiple drawers and what looks like a vase int he corner of it. SO from here you're going to continue all the way down this hallway, past some other rooms on the right and you're gonna keep going and stop once you reach a point where you are next to a brown wall oven on the right and a small sink island with three wooden chairs on the left. Now you're gonna step forward and you're going to stand at the corner of the wall situated next to a set of stairs leading downwards. Now turning to the left, you're gonna walk past the corner of the island and towards another outdoor patio area. So standing just in front of the black frame on the floor, you're gonna take one step over that and then you're going to keep along the right side, walk in front of a grey couch with black and white-striped pillows here and stand in front of that, and you're just going to turn directly to the right until you are facing a blue couch with blue and brown pillows. Take one step forward inside and you are done.
